calls.head: The Devils should pile up the shots
calls.body: The Devils shoot a lot (63.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, 5th in the league), and the Canucks are 31st at keeping shots down. Look for a big shot total.
calls.call: The Devils take at least their usual 63.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 5 games this season
calls.happened: New Jersey took 68.3 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against their usual 63.9.

calls.head: Penalties could cost the Canucks
calls.body: The Canucks’ penalty kill sits 31st in the league, and the Devils’ power play is 7th (8.2 expected goals per 60). Discipline matters more than usual for the Canucks tonight.
calls.call: The Devils’ power play creates at least their usual 8.2 expected goals per 60.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 5 games this season
calls.happened: New Jersey’s power play created 14.0 expected goals per 60 in 4:14 of 5-on-4 time, against their usual 8.2, and scored 3 goals.

NJD.head: We gave New Jersey a 82% chance, and New Jersey delivered.

VAN.head: We gave Vancouver only a 18% chance, and it went the way we feared.

surprises.head: New Jersey leaned on their bottom six
surprises.body: New Jersey’s bottom-six forwards played 45% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against their usual 40% and a league average of 42%. A team strays this far about once every 35 games.

surprises.head: New Jersey brought the hits
surprises.body: New Jersey’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 125, against their usual 78 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 15 games.

story.head: The Devils beat the Canucks
paras: Linus Karlsson opened the scoring early in the first. Nico Hischier added two power-play goals. Vancouver pulled Leevi Meriläinen after three goals.
The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Devils win about seven in ten.

items.text: The Canucks haven’t won in three.
Linus Karlsson scored his first goal of the season.
Both of the preview’s calls held.
